Trace, implement and test: leetcode202 happy number

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution:
    def isHappy(self, n: int) -> bool:
        unhappy = set()
        while n not in unhappy and n != 1:
            unhappy.add(n)
            n = self.GetSquareSum(n)
        return n == 1    

    def GetSquareSum(self, n: int) -> bool:
        sum0 = 0
        while n > 0:
            r = n - int(n/10)*10
            n = int(n/10)
            sum0 += r * r
        return sum0

sol = Solution()
print(sol.isHappy(19))
